message.content:
I'll analyze the world topology first. There's a single customer with one order containing three lines: a damaged laptop (qty 1, return required), a wrong mouse (qty 2, return required), and a hub with missing parts (qty 1, no return required). All lines share the same order, so all line relations are `same_order`. Only settled remedy goals are certifiable, and all three remedies (refund, exchange, reship) are supported.

I'll design a challenge where the customer seeks distinct remedies for each of the three problematic items from the same order.
